# React Three Fiber

## Documentation

- [Introduction](https://docs.pmnd.rs/getting-started/introduction): React-three-fiber is a React renderer for three.js.
- [Installation](https://docs.pmnd.rs/getting-started/installation): Learn how to install react-three-fiber
- [Your first scene](https://docs.pmnd.rs/getting-started/your-first-scene): This guide will help you setup your first React Three Fiber scene and introduce you to its core concepts.
- [Examples](https://docs.pmnd.rs/getting-started/examples): A few examples that demonstrate what you can do with React Three Fiber
- [Canvas](https://docs.pmnd.rs/api/canvas): The Canvas object is your portal into three.js
- [Community R3F Components](https://docs.pmnd.rs/getting-started/community-r3f-components): This page showcases some React Three Fiber/r3f community components that have not been merged to the drei components collection or to another pmndrs project.
- [Objects, properties and constructor arguments](https://docs.pmnd.rs/api/objects): All the effective ways of using React Three Fiber
- [Hooks](https://docs.pmnd.rs/api/hooks): Hooks are the heart of react-three-fiber
- [Events](https://docs.pmnd.rs/api/events): All the events you can hook up to
- [Additional Exports](https://docs.pmnd.rs/api/additional-exports)
- [TypeScript](https://docs.pmnd.rs/api/typescript): Common scenarios and how to approach them with TypeScript
- [Testing](https://docs.pmnd.rs/api/testing): How to handle unit tests
- [Scaling performance](https://docs.pmnd.rs/advanced/scaling-performance): This is a short primer on how to scale performance.
- [Performance pitfalls](https://docs.pmnd.rs/advanced/pitfalls): Performance 1x1
- [v9 Migration Guide](https://docs.pmnd.rs/tutorials/v9-migration-guide): Changes and new features with v9 and React 19
- [Events and Interaction](https://docs.pmnd.rs/tutorials/events-and-interaction): Let's make our meshes react to user input.
- [Loading Models](https://docs.pmnd.rs/tutorials/loading-models): 3D Software to the web!
- [Loading Textures](https://docs.pmnd.rs/tutorials/loading-textures): Let's load some fancy textures.
- [Basic Animations](https://docs.pmnd.rs/tutorials/basic-animations): This guide will help you understand refs, useFrame and how to make basic animations with Fiber
- [How does it work?](https://docs.pmnd.rs/tutorials/how-it-works): This is an advanced guide on the inner workings of Fiber, if you are just getting started, take a look at our introduction!

## MCP Server

This documentation is available via Model Context Protocol (MCP) server at https://docs.pmnd.rs/api/sse

Configure in your MCP client:
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "pmndrs": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/client-sse", "https://docs.pmnd.rs/api/sse"]
    }
  }
}
```
